text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to 15% complete for release v2.14.3 on eu-west-1. Post-deploy quickchecks kicking off — this thread for smoke results.

marta: running quick synthetic suite now (health + generate + embed sample). will paste results.

ian: FYI I saw a small p99 bump on embeds earlier. watching p95/p99 and 5xx; tagging @shawn

devops-jen: running curl checks /health and simple generate probe
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' https://api.eu1.redwood/v1/health
curl -s -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"short"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -w '\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'
```

shawn: seeing intermittent 502s from gateway -> model-proxy (1/50). gathering worker logs.

troubleshoot-bot: Alert: worker restart count increased on rwd-eu-32 (3 restarts in last 5m)

marta: synthetic results (first pass): /health 200 OK; /v1/generate p50=120ms p95=380ms p99=1.2s; 502s=3/200 requests. embed route p95=420ms.

ian: let's run a longer-prefix synthetic to exercise KV cache (prefix=512 tokens) — that was the scenario that regressed last time.

devops-jen: running focused run now, will paste output when done (~2m)

(devops-jen posts)
devops-jen: focused run results: p95=370ms, p99 spikes to 1.1s; one 503 with body "KVCache timeout" from worker rwd-eu-32

shawn: checking runtime logs: saw repeated 'KVCache fetch timed out' and 'retry_count exceeded' around the 14:08:21 window. also a quantization fallback warning but not errors.

marta: root cause unclear but hit rate on one worker causing cache stall. recommendation: pin canary to v2.14.2 (previous variant) and pause rollout until hotfix. will this affect global rollout?

ian: +1 to pin. we shouldn't continue to ramp until we confirm cache fix. create rollback/pin in deploy-bot.

devops-jen: updating deploy-bot: pausing further canary ramps and pinning canary traffic to v2.14.2 now. scheduling a hotfix runbook and follow-up verification at +10m.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Canary pinned to v2.14.2 for eu-west-1. Post-deploy recheck scheduled at 6123456890. Notifying on-call and release manager. :white_check_mark:

marta: creating a short release-note/incident note in the release channel and adding the quick synthetic traces to the ticket.

shawn: I'll keep digging on worker rwd-eu-32, adding logs to the ticket. If no new 5xx after pin we can reattempt rollout later in the change window.

ian: thanks all — follow-ups on the ticket. If anyone sees >1% 5xx after pin, escalate to pager.

devops-jen: ack :thumbsup:
